ignoreValues.reason: Faithful parody of Wikipedia's real interface: font-family intentionally matches Wikipedia's actual declared sans stack (Helvetica Neue/Arial/sans-serif), a source-is-itself-an-interface-language exception, not an unconsidered default.

Tab-strip pattern (Article/Talk/Read/Edit tabs): the active tab's bottom border is intentionally flush with the content panel's top border, the standard browser/OS tab convention this Wikipedia parody reproduces — adding bottom inset would break the tab illusion, not fix a defect.
